<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_sequences_the_odd_step_sets_exactly_one_further_bit_for_every_n">the_odd_step_sets_exactly_one_further_bit_for_every_n</a></h3>
<pre><code>∀ n : Nat, popcount (2 * n + 1) = popcount n + 1</code></pre>

</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="sequences.lean" data-how="for every value">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_sequences_thue_morse_doubling_recurrence_for_every_n">thue_morse_doubling_recurrence_for_every_n</a></h3>
<pre><code>∀ n : Nat, tm (2 * n) = tm n ∧ tm (2 * n + 1) = 1 - tm n</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Sequences · sequences.lean · the ring · for every value</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="sequences.lean" data-how="for every value">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_sequences_halving_removes_exactly_the_low_bit_for_every_n">halving_removes_exactly_the_low_bit_for_every_n</a></h3>
<pre><code>∀ n : Nat, popcount n = n % 2 + popcount (n / 2)</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Sequences · sequences.lean · the ring · for every value</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="sequences.lean" data-how="for every value">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_sequences_the_thue_morse_halving_recurrence_for_every_n">the_thue_morse_halving_recurrence_for_every_n</a></h3>
<pre><code>∀ n : Nat, tm n = (n % 2 + tm (n / 2)) % 2</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Sequences · sequences.lean · the ring · for every value</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="sequences.lean" data-how="for every value">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_sequences_doubling_shifts_every_bit_up_by_one">doubling_shifts_every_bit_up_by_one</a></h3>
<pre><code>∀ m i : Nat, 2 * m / 2 ^ (i + 1) = m / 2 ^ i</code></pre>

</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="sequences.lean" data-how="for every value">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_sequences_the_residue_below_the_next_power_adds_one_bit">the_residue_below_the_next_power_adds_one_bit</a></h3>
<pre><code>∀ m F : Nat, m % 2 ^ (F + 1) = m % 2 ^ F + m / 2 ^ F % 2 * 2 ^ F</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Sequences · sequences.lean · the ring · for every value</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="sequences.lean" data-how="for every value">

<pre><code>∀ F m : Nat, (List.range F).foldl (fun a i =&gt; a + m / 2 ^ i % 2 * 2 ^ i) 0 = m % 2 ^ F</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Sequences · sequences.lean · the ring · for every value</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="sequences.lean" data-how="for every value">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_sequences_the_number_is_rebuilt_from_its_bits_for_every_n">the_number_is_rebuilt_from_its_bits_for_every_n</a></h3>

<pre><code>(orbit6.filter (fun d =&gt; [3, 6, 9].contains (refl d))).length = 3 ∧ (orbit6.filter (fun d =&gt; ! [3, 6, 9].contains (refl d))).length = 3</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Z9Plus · z9plus.lean · the ring · by exhaustion</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="by exhaustion">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_z9plus_the_crossing_pairs_are_one_four_seven">the_crossing_pairs_are_one_four_seven</a></h3>
<pre><code>(orbit6.filter (fun d =&gt; [3, 6, 9].contains (refl d))) = [1, 4, 7] ∧ refl 1 = 9 ∧ refl 4 = 6 ∧ refl 7 = 3</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Z9Plus · z9plus.lean · the ring · by exhaustion</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="by exhaustion">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_z9plus_reflection_is_injective_on_the_orbit">reflection_is_injective_on_the_orbit</a></h3>
<pre><code>((orbit6.map refl).eraseDups).length = 6</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Z9Plus · z9plus.lean · the ring · by exhaustion</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="by exhaustion">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_z9plus_doubling_alone_reaches_only_the_units">doubling_alone_reaches_only_the_units</a></h3>
<pre><code>((List.range 12).map (fun k =&gt; pw 2 k)).eraseDups.length = 6 ∧ ((List.range 12).map (fun k =&gt; pw 2 k)).all (fun d =&gt; ! [0, 3, 6].contains d)</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Z9Plus · z9plus.lean · the ring · by exhaustion</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="by exhaustion">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_z9plus_reflection_alone_reaches_only_two">reflection_alone_reaches_only_two</a></h3>
<pre><code>(closure 6 [1]).length ≥ 2 ∧ rfl9 1 = 0 ∧ rfl9 (rfl9 1) = 1</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Z9Plus · z9plus.lean · the ring · by exhaustion</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="by exhaustion">

<pre><code>(closure 4 [1]).length = 9</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Z9Plus · z9plus.lean · the ring · by exhaustion</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="by exhaustion">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_z9plus_every_residue_is_reachable_from_one">every_residue_is_reachable_from_one</a></h3>
<pre><code>(List.range 9).all (fun d =&gt; (closure 4 [1]).contains d)</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Z9Plus · z9plus.lean · the ring · by exhaustion</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="by exhaustion">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_z9plus_the_diameter_is_exactly_four">the_diameter_is_exactly_four</a></h3>
<pre><code>(closure 4 [1]).length = 9 ∧ (closure 3 [1]).length = 7</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Z9Plus · z9plus.lean · the ring · by exhaustion</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="by exhaustion">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_z9plus_the_frontier_grows_by_two_each_round">the_frontier_grows_by_two_each_round</a></h3>
<pre><code>(closure 0 [1]).length = 1 ∧ (closure 1 [1]).length = 3 ∧ (closure 2 [1]).length = 5 ∧ (closure 3 [1]).length = 7 ∧ (closure 4 [1]).length = 9</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Z9Plus · z9plus.lean · the ring · by exhaustion</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="by exhaustion">

<pre><code>m9 ([1,2,4,5,7,8].foldl (· * ·) 1) = 8 ∧ m9 (8 + 1) = 0</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Z9Plus · z9plus.lean · the ring · by exhaustion</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="by exhaustion">

<pre><code>(List.range 30).all (fun k =&gt; fib9 k == fib9 (k + 24))</code></pre>

<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="by exhaustion">

<pre><code>¬ ([1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12].any (fun p =&gt; (List.range 26).all (fun k =&gt; fib9 k == fib9 (k + p))))</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Z9Plus · z9plus.lean · the ring · by exhaustion</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="by exhaustion">

<pre><code>(List.range 20).all (fun n =&gt; fib (n + 2) == fib n + fib (n + 1))</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Z9Plus · z9plus.lean · the ring · by exhaustion</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="by exhaustion">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_z9plus_consecutive_fibonacci_are_coprime">consecutive_fibonacci_are_coprime</a></h3>
<pre><code>(List.range' 1 25).all (fun n =&gt; gcd9 (fib n) (fib (n + 1)) == 1)</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Z9Plus · z9plus.lean · the ring · by exhaustion</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="by exhaustion">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_z9plus_three_five_eight_are_consecutive_fibonacci">three_five_eight_are_consecutive_fibonacci</a></h3>
<pre><code>fib 4 = 3 ∧ fib 5 = 5 ∧ fib 6 = 8 ∧ fib 4 + fib 5 = fib 6</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Z9Plus · z9plus.lean · the ring · by exhaustion</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="by exhaustion">

<pre><code>((R.filter (fun d =&gt; R.any (fun e =&gt; m9 (d * e) == 1))).length + (R.filter (fun d =&gt; ! R.any (fun e =&gt; m9 (d * e) == 1))).length) = 9</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Z9Plus · z9plus.lean · the ring · by exhaustion</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="by exhaustion">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_z9plus_both_parts_sum_to_zero">both_parts_sum_to_zero</a></h3>
<pre><code>m9 ((R.filter (fun d =&gt; R.any (fun e =&gt; m9 (d * e) == 1))).foldl (· + ·) 0) == 0 ∧ m9 ((R.filter (fun d =&gt; ! R.any (fun e =&gt; m9 (d * e) == 1))).foldl (· + ·) 0) == 0</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Z9Plus · z9plus.lean · the ring · by exhaustion</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="for every value">

<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="for every value">

</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="for every value">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_z9plus_fibonacci_residues_mod_nine_repeat_every_twenty_four_steps">fibonacci_residues_mod_nine_repeat_every_twenty_four_steps</a></h3>
<pre><code>∀ k : Nat, fib (k + 24) % 9 = fib k % 9 ∧ fib (k + 25) % 9 = fib (k + 1) % 9</code></pre>

</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="for every value">

<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="for every value">

<pre><code>∀ f a b : Nat, b &lt; f → gcdF f a b = Nat.gcd a b</code></pre>

</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="for every value">

<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="for every value">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_z9plus_consecutive_fibonacci_are_coprime_for_every_n">consecutive_fibonacci_are_coprime_for_every_n</a></h3>
<pre><code>∀ n : Nat, gcd9 (fib n) (fib (n + 1)) = 1</code></pre>

<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="for every value">

<pre><code>∀ n : Nat, 0 &lt; n → (dr n = 9 ↔ m9 n = 0)</code></pre>

<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="for every value">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_z9plus_digital_root_is_the_digit_sum_residue_for_every_n">digital_root_is_the_digit_sum_residue_for_every_n</a></h3>

<p class="meta">Z9Plus · z9plus.lean · the ring · for every value</p>

<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="for every value">

<pre><code>∀ k : Nat, pw 5 (k + 6) = pw 5 k</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Z9Plus · z9plus.lean · the ring · for every value</p>
</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="for every value">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_z9plus_halving_orbit_digital_roots_have_period_six_for_every_k">halving_orbit_digital_roots_have_period_six_for_every_k</a></h3>
<pre><code>∀ k : Nat, dr (pw 5 (k + 6)) = dr (pw 5 k)</code></pre>
<p class="meta">Z9Plus · z9plus.lean · the ring · for every value</p>

<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="for every value">
<h3><a href="/theorem/lean_z9plus_the_reflected_orbit_meets_the_triad_exactly_at_one_four_seven_for_every_k">the_reflected_orbit_meets_the_triad_exactly_at_one_four_seven_for_every_k</a></h3>
<pre><code>∀ k : Nat, [3, 6, 9].contains (refl (pw 2 k)) = [1, 4, 7].contains (pw 2 k)</code></pre>

</article>
<article class="fx" data-wing="the ring" data-file="z9plus.lean" data-how="for every value">

<style>
.fx-controls{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem;align-items:center;margin:1rem 0;position:sticky;top:var(--vp-nav-height,64px);background:var(--vp-c-bg);padding:.6rem 0;z-index:10}
.fx-controls input,.fx-controls select{padding:.4rem .6rem;border:1px solid var(--vp-c-divider);border-radius:6px;background:var(--vp-c-bg-soft);color:var(--vp-c-text-1)}
.fx-controls input{flex:1 1 18rem}
#fx-count{margin:0;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--vp-c-text-2);white-space:nowrap}
.fx{border-top:1px solid var(--vp-c-divider);padding:.8rem 0}
.fx h3{margin:0 0 .3rem;font-size:1rem}
.fx pre{margin:.2rem 0;overflow-x:auto}
.fx .meta{margin:.2rem 0 0;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--vp-c-text-2)}
</style>

<script setup>
// A BARE <script> IN VITEPRESS MARKDOWN BECOMES THE COMPONENT'S SCRIPT BLOCK and runs before the page is
// mounted, so document.getElementById would return null and every filter would be dead on arrival — a
// page that renders perfectly and does nothing, which is the worst kind because it looks finished.
// A setup block with onMounted is the documented pattern and runs when the nodes exist.
import { onMounted } from 'vue'
onMounted(() => {
  const q = document.getElementById('fx-q'), w = document.getElementById('fx-wing')
  const f = document.getElementById('fx-file'), h = document.getElementById('fx-how')
  const count = document.getElementById('fx-count'), items = [...document.querySelectorAll('.fx')]
  if (!q || !count || !items.length) return
  const apply = () => {
    const t = (q.value || '').toLowerCase()
    let shown = 0
    for (const el of items) {
      const ok = (!t || el.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(t))
        && (!w.value || el.dataset.wing === w.value)
        && (!f.value || el.dataset.file === f.value)
        && (!h.value || el.dataset.how === h.value)
      el.style.display = ok ? '' : 'none'
      if (ok) shown++
    }
    // THE COUNT IS SHOWN SO A FILTER MATCHING NOTHING CANNOT LOOK LIKE AN EMPTY DEPOSIT.
    count.textContent = shown + ' of ' + items.length + (shown === 0 ? ' — nothing matches that filter' : '')
  }
  for (const el of [q, w, f, h]) el.addEventListener('input', apply)
  apply()
})
</script>
